newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA OMIT MANJREKAR, KAMBLI FROM TEST SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA OMIT MANJREKAR, KAMBLI FROM TEST SQUAD.

text.p: Sanjay Manjrekar and Vinod Kambli were surprise omissions from
India's 14-man squad for the one-off test against Australia
which begins in New Delhi on Thursday.
The selectors also dropped left-arm spinner Venkatapathy
Raju. Four spinners remain in the squad.
The only new face is Hyderabad batsman Vangipurappu Laxman
while uncapped medium pacer David Johnson, who went to Canada
and Sri Lanka for one-day tournaments, is also in the squad.
Squad: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Vikram Rathore, Nayan
Mongia, Saurav Ganguly, Mohammad Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid,
Vangipurappu Laxman, Sunil Joshi, Anil Kumble, Aashish Kapoor,
Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad, Narendra Hirwani, David
